description:
Departament: Digital Transformation

We're looking for a Software Solutions Architect with a genuine passion for technology to join our Digital Transformation team in Bucharest.

Skills and competencies required:

  • Data modeling and database design experience
  • Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes
  • Experience with service oriented architecture (SOA)
  • Proven experience developing strategic system architecture plans
  • Extensive experience in system and network creation and development
  • Experience conducting technology, trends, standards and products research
  • Experience providing guidance and leadership to novice systems engineers
  • Broad and extensive knowledge of the software development process and its technologies
  • Knowledge of architectural styles and design patterns
  • Understanding of various coding methods and computer languages
  • Proven experience identifying, analyzing and resolving system problems
  • Familiarity and expertise in a variety of programs
  • Computer servers– Be familiar with DNS, file servers, mail servers and NAS equipment
  • Cloud services - Be familiar with cloud computing building blocks, automation and cloud-enablement.
  • Familiar with writing requirements, system and interface design documents
  • Experience with using UML to describe system views
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and associated tools and technologies
  • Ability to capture non-functional requirements for performance, security, privacy and include them in the solution design
  • Solid track record in prioritizing and executing tasks when under extreme pressure
  • Solid understanding of information processing fundamentals and best practices
  • Above-average analytical, conceptual and troubleshooting abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Day to day responsibilities:

  • Building and integrating information systems to meet the company’s needs
  • Assessing the systems architecture currently in place and working with technical staff to recommend solutions to improve it
  • Resolving technical problems as they arise.
  • Providing supervision and guidance to development teams
  • Continually researching current and emerging technologies and proposing changes where needed
  • Informing various stakeholders about any problems with the current technical solutions being implemented
  • Assessing the business impact that certain technical choices have
  • Providing updates to stakeholders on product development processes, costs, and budgets.

For this position, the company reserves the right to request professional references and/or letters of recommendation.
